description: Answer key for runtime-trace.otlp.json. Each triple is what assemble_trace_tree() must extract from the recorded trace: (service, operation, edge-kind). SERVER spans become EXPOSES, CLIENT spans CALLS. The operation for the BFF→API and API SERVER spans is /api/orders — the same path the static analyzer benchmark resolves the C# [HttpGet] contract to, so a reconcile against the static graph would mark http.GET./api/orders exercised.
